lines.text: Over twenty thousand people signed up for this hackathon. Somebody has to check all of that. That's you.

lines.text: So I built something for you.

lines.text: This is Hearsay. You write what your customers say. Hearsay plays it against your add-on, clean and misheard, and fails the build when it would go wrong out loud.
lines.direction: Fast, precise, confident narrator for a developer-tool launch. Crisp and clear, brisk pace, no drawn-out words. A confident reveal on 'This is Hearsay'.

lines.text: Same add-on, now under Hearsay. Fifty instead of fifteen, and nobody asked. A no that placed the order anyway.

lines.text: Every finding cites the rule it breaks, and most are Amazon's own requirements for add-ons.
lines.direction: Fast, precise, confident narrator for a developer-tool launch. Crisp and clear, brisk pace, no drawn-out words.

lines.text: Twenty errors. The pull request fails.
lines.direction: Fast, precise, confident narrator for a developer-tool launch. Crisp and clear, brisk pace, no drawn-out words. Short and dry.

lines.text: You don't even have to fix it yourself. Hearsay is also an MCP server. Your coding agent runs it, fixes what it finds, and checks again.
lines.direction: Fast, precise, confident narrator for a developer-tool launch. Crisp and clear, brisk pace, no drawn-out words.

lines.text: And it can't cheat. The suite is locked, and some cases it never gets to see.

lines.text: Hearsay stands in for the parts Amazon runs, speech recognition and the model, straight from your test cases. No microphone, no API keys, the same result every time. So it runs on every pull request.

lines.text: We measured it with coding agents. A suite alone made them stop at green, so Hearsay now shows what your suite doesn't cover. Now they leave zero defects behind, and do better on the rules nobody told them about.
lines.direction: Fast, precise, confident narrator for a developer-tool launch. Crisp and clear, brisk pace, no drawn-out words.

lines.text: Everything you saw is a real run, and you can repeat every one of them. Hearsay is open source. Point it at your add-on, before your customers do.
lines.direction: Fast, precise, confident narrator for a developer-tool launch. Crisp and clear, brisk pace, no drawn-out words. Warm, inviting finish.
